description:
Get past USD prices for a crypto asset (ETH, BTC, SOL, LINK and others with a Chainlink feed) over up to 365 days: up to 100 points read from Chainlink's on-chain price feed on Ethereum, each with its time and round, plus first, last, high, low and percent change.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You need past prices for a major asset: a trend, a high or low, or the change over a period.
Use instead: token_price for the current price of any token, including ones without a Chainlink feed.
Parameters: asset: a symbol with a Chainlink USD feed (ETH, BTC, SOL, LINK and others). days: 1-365, default 7. points: 2-100 evenly spaced prices, default 24.
Returns: points[] each with time, price_usd and Chainlink round, plus first, last, high, low and percent change.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: price_history
title: Crypto price history
